terminology_rows.note: Materials like GST or VO2 that switch between amorphous and crystalline states to alter refractive index non-volatily.
The fundamental constraint where optimizing one parameter (e.g., speed) inherently degrades at least one other (efficiency or bandwidth) in active metasurfaces.
Systems using mechanical deformation (MEMS or stretchable substrates) to physically alter meta-atom geometry for phase control.
